data.one_liner: An animated circular menu widget for Flutter with adjustable radius, colors, and angles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable and animated circular menu component where multiple menu items radiate outward from a toggle button. It supports alignment positioning, custom angles, badges, and animations.
use_when: You want a radial or circular floating menu for actions.
You need multiple circular menus inside the same screen using MultiCircularMenu.
avoid_when: You need a standard linear or dropdown menu layout.
You are building a dense application toolbar requiring traditional navigation bars.
strengths: Highly customizable radius, colors, alignment, and animation curves.
Supports badges on menu items and multiple menus on a single screen.
weaknesses: Limited to circular layouts, which might not fit standard UX patterns for all apps.
Not documented for complex gesture-based radial interactions beyond simple taps.
